Name: Upgrade Empty Cabins
Author: CherryChain
Description:
Lets you upgrade, renovate, and paint uninhabited cabins. You can also move their beds and open their gift boxes.


[b][size=5]Install[/size][/b]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[b][size=5]How to use[/size][/b]
[b][size=3]Upgrade cabin[/size][/b]
Interact with the left corner of Robin's shop counter to upgrade empty cabins. You can also enter [font=Courier New]upgrade_cabin[/font] in the SMAPI console window to show the menu anytime.

[b][size=3]Change cabin appearance[/size][/b]
Normally you can't change the appearance of someone else's cabin. That no longer applies to empty cabins when this mod is installed, so you can change their appearance through Robin's normal menu like any other building.

[b][size=3]Move beds and open gift boxes[/size][/b]
Normally you can't place/move beds or open the gift box in someone else's cabin. That no longer applies to empty cabins when this mod is installed.

[b][size=3]More features using console commands[/size][/b]
You can make other changes to cabins by entering commands directly into the SMAPI console window.

First, enter the [font=Courier New]list_cabins[/font] command to get a list of empty cabins in your save. If you're not sure which cabin is the one you want, just enter the command while you're inside it; that cabin will say "You are here" in the list. For example:
[quote][b]list_cabins[/b]
[i]You have 2 empty cabins in this save:
[/i][list=1]
[*][i]Plank Cabin at tile position 89 24, not upgraded yet. You are here.[/i]
[*][i]Stone Cabin at tile position 83 24, not upgraded yet.[/i]
[/list][i]
You can use the cabin number in other commands, like `remove_seed_box 1` to remove it from the first cabin above.
[/i][/quote]
Next, enter one of the console commands to make the change you want:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]renovate_cabin <cabin number>[/font] — remove cribs and apply all renovations to a cabin.
[*][font=Courier New]set_crib_style <cabin number> <crib style>[/font] — change which baby crib appears in a cabin. The vanilla styles are [font=Courier New]0[/font] (disabled) and [font=Courier New]1[/font] (enabled).
[*][font=Courier New]toggle_renovation <cabin number> <renovation id>[/font] — add or remove a specific renovation for a cabin. You can enter the [font=Courier New]list_renovations[/font] command to get a list of renovation IDs.
[/list]
For example, to add the crib to the Plank Cabin in the example above:
[quote][b]set_crib_style 1 1[/b]
[i]Crib style 1 set for Plank Cabin at tile position 89 24.[/i][/quote]

[b][size=5]Common questions[/size][/b]
[quote][size=3][b]Is the mod still compatible?[/b][/size]
The mod is compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later on Linux/macOS/Windows, both single-player and multiplayer.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Does the mod conflict with any others?[/b][/size]
There are no known mod conflicts. Feel free to report compatibility issues in the mod comments.[/quote][quote][size=3][b]Can I safely add/remove the mod anytime?[/b][/size]
Yep, the mod makes no custom changes to your save beyond the specific changes you request.[/quote]
